question: What was the role of the India Council established by the Government of India Act, 1858?

options.text: To advise the Secretary of State
To represent Indian opinion in Britain

solution:
The correct answer is __**To advise the Secretary of State**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **India Council** was established by the **Government of India Act, 1858**, following the transfer of power from the East India Company to the British Crown. 
• The Council was composed of **15 members**, most of whom were experienced officials with knowledge of Indian affairs. 
• Its primary role was to **advise the Secretary of State for India**, who was responsible for overseeing Indian administration from Britain. 
• The Council ensured continuity in governance by providing expert opinions on issues such as **financial administration, military strategy, and legislation**.
